claim: An RML <script src> cannot load in the host: the host loads documents by absolute path, RmlUi keeps the drive as C|/ in URLs and Interpreter::LoadFile passes that straight to the file interface (LoadFile: Unable to open file: C|/...), so board.lua never ran and its data model was missing. Inline <script> works (RmlUi reads it as CDATA; a CDATA wrapper reaches Lua as text). The viewer's paths have no drive, so it never shows there. J35 needs a host FileInterface that maps | back to :; until then game copies inline their scripts
